Where Can I Buy Velositol? How to Choose a Velositol and MyoVera Supplement

Where can you buy Velositol? Learn how to check dosage, licensed ingredients, Certificates of Analysis, and the VINATURA Velositol® 2G product.

By Velositol.co Editorial TeamEditorial draftUpdated August 6, 20265 min read
V

After learning about Velositol, the next question is usually: Where can I buy Velositol?

Velositol can appear in protein powders, amino acid blends, creatine formulas, or as a standalone supplement. Before choosing a product, buyers should check not only the ingredient name but also the dosage, serving size, and supporting testing documentation.

Velositol or MyoVera: Which Name Should You Look For?

Everwell Health now markets this ingredient under the name MyoVera™. MyoVera is described as a patented ingredient containing two forms of chromium, developed to support muscle protein utilization, strength, and physical performance.

Ingredient name

MyoVera™ is the new brand name for the patented ingredient previously known as Velositol®.

Products already licensed under the Velositol name may continue to use that name and trademark. As a result, consumers may encounter either name while researching products.

Verify the Licensed Ingredient

Not every product combining amylopectin and chromium is automatically Velositol or MyoVera.

When evaluating a product, check for:

  • Use of the official Velositol® or MyoVera™ name
  • Attribution to the ingredient's rights holder
  • Clearly stated trademark or patent information
  • Ingredient content disclosed per serving

The published Velositol studies evaluated a specific amylopectin-chromium complex. Those results do not automatically apply to any generic blend containing similar-sounding ingredients.

Check the Velositol Amount Per Serving

Both published human studies used 2 grams of the amylopectin-chromium complex.

Buyers should check:

  • Whether the amount is listed per serving or per capsule
  • How many capsules or scoops make up one serving
  • Whether the formula provides 2 grams or a lower amount
  • Whether the label clearly discloses the chromium content

This doesn't mean a product providing less than 2 grams has no effect — but 2 grams is the amount that directly matches the published human study protocols.

Check the Certificate of Analysis

A Certificate of Analysis, or CoA, is a laboratory report for a specific production batch. It may show whether the product was tested for:

  • Identity
  • Potency
  • Microbial testing
  • Heavy metals
  • Lot number
  • Manufacturing or testing date

A CoA should be matched against the lot number on the product itself. A test report for an older lot doesn't necessarily represent every batch produced afterward.

Buyers should also distinguish between:

  • A general “lab tested” claim
  • An actual CoA that includes a specific lab, method, results, and lot number

What Are the Advantages of a Standalone Capsule?

Velositol is often included in a protein powder or multi-ingredient blend, which can suit people who want every ingredient in one product.

A standalone capsule may be a better fit for people who:

  • Already have a preferred whey or plant protein
  • Don't want to switch flavors or protein brands
  • Want to know exactly how much Velositol they're taking
  • Want to separate Velositol from creatine, leucine, or other ingredients
  • Want to pair it with a protein-containing meal

A standalone format doesn't automatically make Velositol more effective. Its main advantage lies in serving-size control and flexibility with an existing protein routine.

VINATURA Velositol® 2G

VINATURA Velositol® 2G is a standalone capsule supplement that provides:

  • 2 grams of licensed Velositol® per serving
  • 1,000 mcg of chromium
  • 1.7 grams of carbohydrate
  • Three capsules per serving
  • 90 capsules and 30 servings per bottle

The product is intended to be taken alongside a protein-containing meal or shake. The 2-gram amount matches the dose of the complex used in the 2017 and 2021 human studies.

The VINATURA product page also publishes testing documentation for a specific lot, including identity, chromium content, microbial testing, and heavy metals. Buyers should check the current lot number to confirm which documentation applies to their product.

Where Can I Buy Velositol?

Consumers can check current availability of VINATURA Velositol® 2G on VINATURA's official product page. Pricing, stock, and shipping times may change, so it's best to confirm details directly at the time of purchase.

When buying Velositol or MyoVera from any brand, prioritize products that offer:

  • A licensed, branded ingredient
  • Clearly stated content per serving
  • A complete Supplement Facts panel
  • Disclosed chromium content
  • Third-party testing
  • A CoA with a lot number
  • Clear manufacturer information and usage warnings

Conclusion

Where to buy is only part of the decision. What matters more is confirming that a product uses a licensed ingredient, provides an amount aligned with your goals, and offers transparent testing documentation.

VINATURA Velositol® 2G provides 2 grams of licensed Velositol in a standalone capsule, allowing users to keep their existing protein routine unchanged. This standalone format may suit people who want to add Velositol to their existing protein routine without changing their preferred protein powder, shake, or meal plan.
